legal_and_guidance_basis.reference: Guidelines 9/2022 on personal data breach notification under GDPR, version 2.0
Data breaches — SME data protection guide

covered_data: raw and normalised AI4WORK respondent records
canonical respondent-level exports before terminal disclosure control
research-only storage and backups containing respondent-level data
server or application logs if they contain or can be linked to personal data

breach_definition: A security incident leading to accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to personal data is handled as a potential personal data breach until assessed and documented.

awareness_and_clock.awareness_rule: Record the earliest timestamp at which there is a reasonable degree of certainty that a security incident occurred and compromised personal data.
awareness_and_clock.delay_rule: If notification is required and occurs after 72 hours, the delay reason must be documented and supplied with the notification.

risk_decision.dpa_notification: Notify the competent supervisory authority unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
risk_decision.data_subject_communication: Communicate without undue delay when the personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, unless a documented Article 34 exception applies.
minimum_assessment_dimensions: nature and sensitivity of affected data
approximate number and categories of affected data subjects
approximate number and categories of affected records
effectiveness of encryption or other protection

security_and_data_minimisation.retention_rule: Incident/breach documentation retention must be separately approved and justified; the ordinary research respondent-retention schedule must not be silently extended for all respondent records merely because an incident occurred.
security_and_data_minimisation.rights_hold_rule: Any incident-specific legal or audit hold must use the authoritative rights-hold mechanism and must be purpose-bounded, documented and approved.

external_communication_boundary.rule: Automation may detect, contain where pre-authorised, calculate deadlines, assemble factual drafts and escalate. It must not submit a supervisory-authority notification or contact affected individuals in the controller's name without explicit human/controller authorization.
external_communication_boundary.urgency_rule: The human authorization boundary must not suppress or delay escalation of a potentially notifiable breach; escalation must surface the 72-hour legal clock immediately.

required_before_resume_after_material_in: DPIA/LIA/Article 13 reassessed when the incident changes risk or processing facts

forbidden_shortcuts: treating repository CI as proof of live incident-readiness
treating provider marketing documentation as proof of account-specific breach escalation
writing breach or incident records into commercial CRM
using TEST TWIN incident simulations as evidence of real respondent behaviour or real breach handling
automatically notifying ANSPDCP or data subjects without controller authorization
resuming collection automatically after a material security incident
